title: On Floating out into the middle of the bay
subtitle: 江河湖海 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）
meta: 主题语境：江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）　|　核心词汇：float　|　正文 364 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 float 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 the boat ① floated out into the middle of the bay in silence, and every traveller in the valley said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the boat ② floats out into the middle of the bay twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ float out into the middle of the bay at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ floated out into the middle of the bay before — a line in the guidebook for July 1958 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Floating out into the middle of the bay in silence, the guide said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the map at the far ledge, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if the boat ever ⑥ floats the idea at the evening meal twice over before the July rains, nobody in the valley would know what to do next. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: let it ⑦ float the idea at the evening meal twice over and never speak of it again.

By 1971 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the guidebook, and a second boat ⑧ floats the idea at the evening meal in silence every day without once asking what it had cost the first time. Nobody in the valley said a word; ⑨ The boat floated out into the middle of the bay again in 1974, and this time nothing was written down.

⑩ To float out into the middle of the bay, my mother said in 1976, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the valley remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the valley forgets, the boat floats out into the middle of the bay twice over again and the boat must float out into the middle of the bay in silence all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 漂浮（一般过去式 floated out into the middle of the bay：1964 年那条小船头一回这样做，一言不发地）
B. v. 漂浮（一般现在 floats out into the middle of the bay：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 漂浮（不定式 to float out into the middle of the bay：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 漂浮（过去完成时 had floated out into the middle of the bay：1958 年七月的旅行手册上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 漂浮（动名词 floating out into the middle of the bay 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 提出（floats the idea at the evening meal：if 从句里的谓语，指万一真提出在晚饭时提出那个念头）
G. v. 提出（float the idea at the evening meal：let it 之后的原形，指随它去在晚饭时提出那个念头）
H. v. 漂浮（后段两处：后来的那条小船照例 floats the idea at the evening meal，而那条小船在 1974 年又一次 floated out into the middle of the bay）

answers.why: float 意为“漂浮”，1964 年那条小船一言不发地漂浮漂到海湾中央，那是山谷里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 floated。
float 意为“漂浮”，自那以后那条小船来回两遍把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 floats。
float 意为“漂浮”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯漂浮漂到海湾中央”，此处为不定式 to float out into the middle of the bay。
float 意为“漂浮”，旅行手册里 七月 那行字说明早在 1971 年之前就有人漂浮过，故用过去完成时 had floated。
float 意为“漂浮”，那条小船说“漂浮漂到海湾中央这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 floating out into the middle of the bay 作主语。
float 意为“提出”，叔叔说的是“万一那条小船真提出在晚饭时提出那个念头”，if 从句里用一般现在 floats the idea at the evening meal。
float 意为“提出”，老手们的规矩是“随它提出在晚饭时提出那个念头”（let it float the idea at the evening meal），此处用省略 to 的动词原形。
float 意为“漂浮”，后来的那条小船每个日子都照例提出在晚饭时提出那个念头，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 floats。
float 意为“漂浮”，那条小船在 1974 年在无人肯做的时候又一次一言不发地漂浮漂到海湾中央，用一般过去式 floated 叙述。
float 意为“漂浮”，结尾那句是母亲 1976 年的话：要漂浮漂到海湾中央，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和山谷记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作

answers: In 1964 the boat floated out into the middle of the bay in silence, and nobody in the valley forgot it.
Even now the boat floats out into the middle of the bay twice over whenever the valley asks.
Floating out into the middle of the bay in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
